how_original_was_tied: per reserved-domain request: read the composition document named by the record's composition_ref (by the version its ARTIFACT# row records, digest checked), took the input id(s) it names, read that INPUT# row, its UPLOAD# row, and checked that the upload's original artifact has an ARTIFACT# row; counted not_resolved when any step failed or no input id was named
owner_address_member_read: owner.principal_id (a string; every one of the 52 held an at-sign, so none was counted no-address)
owner_class_member_read: owner.principal_class (member of the acceptance record's owner sub-record)
reserved_rule: domain after the last at-sign, lower-cased, equal to example.com, example.org or example.net, or ending .invalid, .test or .example
